note: On board, halfway, with Stop this trip? open. Seed: php artisan mock:sample-day travel --email=<you>; E2E_EMAIL=<you> MOCK_TRIP=started php artisan db:seed --class="Database\\Seeders\\MockSample\\TravelSeeder". The mock resumes the sample's 13:14 at the same step (its own ?journey=resume); the app shows the seeded trip at the moment's clock (cookies.mock_clock). Measuring aids, on both sides alike: a viewport tall enough that the phone's full-screen trip page never scrolls inside itself, and the mock's dashed Sample chip (its own sample tools) taken out of the row and made invisible (still there to pick a moment).
